document.title: Election Commission Integrity Bill Legal Provenance Ledger

claims.text: The Supreme Court of India in Anoop Baranwal v. Union of India mandated a Selection Committee comprising the Prime Minister, Leader of Opposition, and Chief Justice of India for ECI appointments.

authorities.title: Anoop Baranwal v. Union of India

claims.subsequent_history_checked: Overridden by Parliament via Act 49 of 2023.
claims.limitations: Requires Constitutional Amendment under Article 368 to entrench.

claims.text: The Supreme Court in Subramanian Swamy v. ECI held that a paper trail (VVPAT) is an indispensable requirement for free and fair elections.

authorities.title: Subramanian Swamy v. Election Commission of India

claims.limitations: Construes Article 324 and Conduct of Elections Rules.
claims.reviewer_action: Verified against official Supreme Court Judgment.
